idea-plugin.name: EasyFK Generator
idea-plugin.description:
EasyFK Generator

A powerful code generation plugin for the EasyFK Java/Spring Boot framework.

Features

  • Full-stack Generation — Generate complete project skeleton, Entity/Mapper, business code (Repository/Service/API/Controller/Remote), and Spring Boot AutoConfiguration in one click.
  • Incremental Generation — Add new modules or tables to existing projects without affecting current code.
  • Model Refresh — Re-generate Entity/Mapper/DTO/Param when database columns change, keeping your business logic untouched.
  • Database Import — Connect to MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle and import table structures automatically.

Supported Options

  • Project Types: Single / Microservice / Smart (multi-stack microservices)
  • Build Tools: Maven / Gradle (Groovy DSL & Kotlin DSL)
  • ORM: MyBatis / MyBatis-Flex / Hibernate
  • App Types: BMS (backend management) / CLIENT (consumer-facing)
  • RPC: OpenFeign / Dubbo

简介

EasyFK 框架代码生成器 IDEA 插件，支持一键生成项目骨架、Entity/Mapper、业务代码、自动装配配置。

支持 Single / Microservice / Smart 三种项目架构，Maven / Gradle 构建，MyBatis / MyBatis-Flex / Hibernate ORM。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.6 — 项目配置体验优化与 Dubbo 提供者配置调整
  • 项目配置页将“项目类型”改为下拉选择，便于后续继续扩展更多项目类型
  • 调整项目类型下拉顺序为：单体项目、产品层项目、微服务项目、智能型项目
  • 将“项目类型”和“构建工具”调整到同一行显示，并适当增大表单行间距，提升界面紧凑度与可读性
  • 当 ORM、RPC、PRD 选择为 NONE 时，不再写入接口参数与插件配置，避免无效参数传递
  • 更新 Dubbo Provider 配置模板，改为生成 ServiceConfig<IxxxRemote> Bean，并显式执行 setInterface、setRef、export
1.0.5 — Database Import, Config Fixes & UI Improvements
  • Rename generator config key from from-db-tables to db-tables and align plugin behavior with the latest generator engine
  • Complete the "Import Tables from Database" workflow in Model Config, writing selected tables into db-tables instead of mixing them into manual model-list
  • Persist and restore both db-tables and manual model-list in .easyfk-generator.json
  • Add model configuration validation to detect duplicate Model names before generation, and block generation when db-tables and model-list are both empty
  • Improve App Type visibility and validation logic in project configuration
  • Fix model generation error reporting: generation failures are now surfaced to the dialog instead of being reported as success
  • Fix App Type enable/required rules: it is now required for Single, Micro-PRD, and PRD strategy = SINGLE
  • Fix test profile database type configuration for PostgreSQL-based generator verification
  • Replace inline label messages with dialog popups — database connection test results, table import status, and all other notifications are now shown as modal dialogs to prevent layout disruption
  • Remove testResultLabel from Model Config to fix layout overflow caused by long error messages displayed next to the "测试连接" button
  • Remove statusLabel from Database Table Import dialog — success/failure feedback is now delivered via popup dialogs
  • Build the plugin against the local generator source to ensure the bundled plugin uses the latest generator fixes
  • Require IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3+ (build 243)
1.0.4 — UI Improvements
  • Rename project types: Micro-PRD → 产品层项目, Microservice → 微服务项目, Smart → 智能型项目, Single → 单体项目
  • Model Config: move "测试连接" button to the right side of database type selector for compact layout
  • Model Config: replace radio buttons with tabbed pane — "从数据库导入" and "手动创建模型" now coexist as separate tabs, both data sources are merged by the generator engine
  • Model Config: add "清空表名" button next to table prefix field for quick clearing
  • Model Config: remove redundant "模型列表" title to save vertical space
  • Code Config: add top padding to "生成业务代码" tab for better spacing
1.0.3 — Bug Fixes
  • Fix CLI mode ignoring app-type config — CliConfigLoader now correctly parses the app-type field from YAML
  • Fix FreeMarker template error in ModelGenerator — add missing ormType variable to mapper.java.ftl template context
  • Fix incorrect ORM artifact naming — split ormModuleSuffix into framework suffix (orm-mybatis) and business suffix (auth-orm-plus)
  • Add Micro-PRD project type to generator-template.yml comments
1.0.2 — New Features & Improvements
  • Add "Generate All" button — one-click generation: project skeleton → Entity/Mapper → business code → AutoConfiguration with step-by-step progress (1/4, 2/4, 3/4, 4/4)
  • Add Micro-PRD (微服务产品层) project type support with automatic disabling of model generation and AutoConfiguration
  • Add Auth module option — optional checkbox to include the auth permission module in project generation
  • Add PRD strategy dropdown (NONE / SINGLE / SEPARATION) for Microservice and Smart project types
  • Add dynamic UI visibility — ORM, RPC, PRD, and App Type controls auto show/hide based on selected project type
  • Add configuration file management — auto-save .easyfk-generator.json on generation or dialog close, auto-load on dialog open, and manual load from file chooser
  • Add "Reset Config" button to restore all fields to defaults
  • Add global settings persistence — remember last used project dir, GroupId, base package, DB connection, module name across sessions
  • Improve form validation with specific error messages for each field and automatic tab switching to the error location
  • Improve progress display with modal indicator and minimum 2-second display time for better UX
  • Disable all generation buttons during execution to prevent duplicate runs
1.0.1 — Compatibility Fix
  • Fix compatibility with IntelliJ IDEA 2025.2 and later versions
  • Upgrade IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin to 2.11.0
1.0.0 — Initial Release
  • Full-stack generation: project skeleton + Entity/Mapper + business code + AutoConfiguration
  • Six generation modes: Full / Incremental / Model Refresh / Code Only / DTO Only / Config Only
  • Three-tab dialog: Project Config, Model Config, Code Config
  • EasyFK Tool Window with categorized quick-action buttons on the right sidebar
  • Database connection with async test and import table structures (MySQL, PostgreSQL)
  • Editable model table with ID type, Repository-only, and Controller generation toggles
  • DTO/Param refresh panel for selective domain model updates
  • Support Single / Microservice / Smart project architectures
  • Support Maven / Gradle build tools
  • Support MyBatis / MyBatis-Flex / Hibernate ORM frameworks
  • Support BMS / CLIENT application types, OpenFeign / Dubbo RPC
  • Support Logback / Log4j2 logging frameworks
  • Keyboard shortcut: Ctrl+Alt+Z for incremental generation
